name: Precision Packaging Products, Inc.
old_description: Welcome to Precision Packaging Products. You’ve just found the solution to your next custom marketing/packaging project! Our facility located in Tigard, OR is ready to make anywhere from one to 100,000 custom inserts, marketing giveaways, shipping containers or product packages. Send us your specs/ideas and we’ll get working on a quote right away.
about:
Precision Packaging Products, Inc. operates a manufacturing facility in Tigard, Oregon, at 16240 SW 72nd Avenue. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The business focuses on custom packaging manufacturing, producing items such as custom inserts, marketing giveaways, shipping containers, and product packages. It advertises a production range from one unit to 100,000 units, with operating hours Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. No information is provided about facility square footage, employee count, or the specific equipment and processes used.

The company targets customers with custom marketing and packaging projects, serving businesses that need promotional giveaways, shipping containers, and product packaging. Specific industries served or example clients are not identified in the available materials.

Precision Packaging Products states that "Custom is our specialty" and emphasizes its flexibility in handling both prototype and large-volume runs. The company does not describe a founding mission or provide further details on what sets it apart beyond its stated volume range.
